subject: NovaStream Order Form - insurance certificates and COI timing
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novastream.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@novastream.com, contracts@novastream.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Insurance requirements and COI for Order Form RD-745

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — excited to move forward. Our procurement team needs to confirm insurance language before we countersign the Order Form (deal RD-745). I've attached our Certificate Request Form (NovaStream_Certificate_Request_Form.pdf) and summarized our asks below: 

- Additional insured: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, and affiliates" to be named as Additional Insured on the General Liability policy via CG 20 10 (or equivalent endorsement)
- Limits: Commercial General Liability $5,000,000 aggregate / $1,000,000 per occurrence; Auto $1,000,000; Employers Liability $1,000,000; Cyber/Network Security $5,000,000
- Waiver of subrogation: for General Liability and Employers Liability in favor of NovaStream
- 30-day notice of cancellation

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a COI and, if needed, an endorsement, within 10 business days of countersignature? If your carrier cannot add the endorsement immediately we can accept a COI naming Redwood now and a follow-up endorsement within 30 days, but we need the timeline confirmed.

Also copying Maya at Insurely (our broker) in case you want to coordinate directly on endorsements. Please let me know if you need Redwood's legal entity details or a specific billing contact.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Contracts Manager | NovaStream
attachments: NovaStream_Certificate_Request_Form.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novastream.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Insurance requirements and COI for Order Form RD-745

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear summary and the form.

We can move quickly on this. I'll loop Legal and our broker. Initial answers:
- We can provide a COI naming "Redwood Inference, Inc. and Affiliates" as Additional Insured on General Liability; we typically request the Additional Insured be limited to liability arising out of Redwood's services (standard limited AI endorsement).
- Waiver of subrogation is something we'll need to confirm with our carrier; historically we can provide a waiver for GL/EL but cyber waivers are rare.
- 30-day cancellation is standard.

I've attached our Certificate Template for your broker's reference (Redwood_Certificate_Template.pdf). Aditya / Kimberly — can you review the limits above and confirm if Legal wants redlines to the Order Form or MSA? Laura, please drop the HubSpot deal link into the thread and track the COI deliverable (HubSpot deal RD-2027-0745).

Jonas
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Certificate_Template.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Insurance requirements and COI for Order Form RD-745

Jonas / team — quick Legal take after an initial carrier/broker check: 

- Additional Insured: we should accept naming Redwood as AI but limit scope to liability arising out of Redwood's performance under the Order Form (i.e., CG 20 10 or equivalent with limiting language). Full broad form AI is a higher exposure; propose limited AI language for the MSA/Order Form redline.
- Limits: the $5M GL aggregate / $1M each is higher than our standard in some regions but acceptable for this account if procurement insists. We prefer to push for $2M / $1M but can accept $5M if pricing impact is acceptable.
- Waiver of subrogation: we can offer for GL and Employers' Liability, but we cannot agree to a waiver for cyber/privacy coverages (carrier will not endorse). We'll add that explicitly.
- Endorsement timing: offering a COI now with a carrier confirmation and follow-up endorsement within 30 days is reasonable. If NovaStream needs the endorsement up front, we'll need an executed Order Form and a business justification to our carrier to prioritize.

I've uploaded a redline that captures the limited AI and waiver carve-outs (Redwood_Redlines_MSA.docx). Recommend we propose: COI now naming Redwood; carrier to issue a limited AI endorsement within 30 days post-execution.

- Action items:
  1) Jonas: confirm to NovaStream that limited AI + COI-first workflow is acceptable.
  2) Kimberly: coordinate with our broker to get the COI and estimated endorsement lead time.
  3) Laura: update HubSpot task with "COI requested" and expected due date.

Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Redlines_MSA.docx

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novastream.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@novastream.com, Maya Singh <maya.singh@insurely.com>, contracts@novastream.com
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Insurance requirements and COI for Order Form RD-745

Thanks, Aditya and Jonas. We understand the carrier constraints. NovaStream procurement is willing to accept the COI-first approach with a follow-up endorsement within 30 days, with the following confirmation in writing: 

- COI naming "Redwood Inference, Inc. and Affiliates" to be provided within 10 business days of countersignature.
- If the endorsement is not issued within 30 days, NovaStream reserves the right to pause onboarding until the endorsement is confirmed.
- Waiver of subrogation is acceptable for GL/EL only; cyber waiver not required.

Maya (Insurely) — can you coordinate with Redwood's broker and confirm the COI issuance timeframe? If possible, please attach a draft COI or policy excerpt that includes the limited AI language. We will proceed to countersign the Order Form once we see the COI and the DocuSign link — I'm pasting the DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.com/exec/embedded-sign/AAAbbbCCC

Regards,
Priya Shah
Contracts Manager | NovaStream
